instructions: Stealth browser driver. act interacts (navigate/click/type/fill/batch/eval), see reads (extract="auto" first on list/search/product pages; mode="content" for articles; format="json" for pure JSON), state manages cookies/tabs/sessions, run executes step batches with branching and inline reads, vision screenshots (path= saves the PNG, size= sets the viewport, full= takes the whole page). WORK LOOP: navigate -> act by text (no see needed) or by ref (refs are page-scoped: refresh them after a navigation or tab switch; within a page they self-heal) -> every action returns an observation, so a see after acting is usually unnecessary. act eval answers one line, `result: <compact JSON>` (a returned string containing JSON is flagged in a note). Results disclose what the driver cannot verify: page_total/partial (lazy or paginated results), sponsored items, unwrapped redirect links, duplicates removed, and a URL range filter whose page prices fall outside it. Oversized payloads go to an artifact file, read back with see artifact="..." - nothing is truncated silently. Errors carry the current page state; never blind-retry a submit. HOST: {{HOST_NOTE}}

tools.name: act
tools.description:
Interact; verified verdict + page delta, navigate also returns refs/content. Prefer ref, then text/label, then CSS; click x,y overrides other targets. Refs self-heal within a page; refresh after navigation/tab switch. Ambiguity returns candidates: choose ref/selector/nth. Popup clicks keep opener active; switch-tab by returned ID.
Type replaces/verifies text; type+press=Enter submits once. Targeted press focuses first; otherwise current focus. fill sets multiple fields then optionally submits once.
wait text= matches visible page text; selector= traverses open shadows/same-origin frames; condition=element matches visible role/text. title/url match text; js evaluates js= (legacy text=); settle waits DOM quiet; network waits 300ms without tracked requests, excluding streams.
batch runs sequential steps; optional:true continues runtime failures. Plans validate before effects (1000 steps, nesting 32); runtime failures retain prior effects. slim inherits through batch/run, preserves reads/errors. url= navigates first except download/state ops.
Errors carry page state. trusted:false means untrusted input fallback; degraded:true means client deadline/transport failure with unknown outcome. Observe destination before repeating input. Quiet dispatched clicks never replay.

accept.description: act dialog: accept (default true) or cancel the matching dialog.

block.description: navigate: comma-separated images,fonts,media,trackers; applied before loading.

body.description: Download: HTTP body instead of browser attachment, <=32 MiB/30s. No browser cookies; honors HTTP(S) OBU_PROXY, refuses other proxy types; returns status/path.

condition.description: Wait kind; js needs js=, selector uses selector= (or text= with condition=selector). network waits 300ms idle.

expect.description: dialog: alert|confirm|prompt|beforeunload|any|clear; arm before trigger. Other actions: expected navigation|dom-change|none|any.

fields.description: Fill: [{ref|label|selector,text|option|check}]. Toggles accept only check=true/false; omit values to toggle.

format.description: read: live value/toggle state + select options (first 80; clipping explicit). eval/read/extract json: payload, {data,note} for notices, or {artifact,bytes,next_offset:0}; page artifacts with see.

js.description: eval: required JavaScript; ref/selector exposes target as el. wait/if/while condition=js: expression.

key.description: Key or chord: Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace, ArrowDown, Control+a, Meta+Enter, Shift+Tab.

message.description: act dialog: only match dialogs whose text contains this (case-insensitive).

next.description: Paginate: CSS selector or text=Next / label= / ref=.

nth.description: 1-based match index; out of range refuses with the real count.

press.description: type: key/chord to dispatch once after verified typing, e.g. Enter.

prompt_text.description: act dialog: text typed into a matching prompt() when accepting.

ref.description: Page-scoped element ID, e.g. e5; refresh after navigation/tab switch.

role.description: Filter by role (button, textbox, link, etc.).

selector.description: CSS target (including press/wait); open shadows. Wait selectors also traverse same-origin frames. nth disambiguates; hidden targets refuse.

slim.description: Verdicts only for successful actions; batch/run inherit. Reads and errors retained.

steps.description: Sequential act steps (no nested batch), see/extract reads and {action:state,op,...}. Reuse each tool's fields. optional:true continues runtime failures; otherwise stops with prior results/page state. Navigation continues on the new page.

submit.description: Fill: ref or text of submit button. Dispatched once; inspect the verdict before repeating.

target_id.description: close-tab/switch-tab: ID returned by state tabs/open-tab.

text.description: click/hover: visible text; type: replacement value; upload: file path; wait: match text. navigate uses url=.

url.description: navigate requires url; download uses file URL; other actions navigate first except state ops (cookie scope/tab URL).

x.description: click: viewport CSS pixels; supply both x and y. Coordinates override other targets.

tools.name: see
tools.description:
Read: model gives refs, content rendered markdown, outline headings. extract=auto detects list/search/product/site fields; preview=true samples schema without rows. Reddit comments disclose complete/partial, API denial and fuzzed_score; sort overrides page sort. Opaque redirects are flagged. find searches text; scope narrows reads. Logs: console=current document, network=current navigation; clear=true reads then clears.
format=json: payload, {data,note} for caveats/events, or artifact envelope. Default artifact pages are character chunks: concatenate data strings before parsing payload. items=true pages JSON array rows independently. next_offset=0 starts paging; null ends. changes=true gives model delta since last capture (JSON supported). Large reads offload; inspect partial/limit notes.

artifact.description: Read a previously offloaded payload from disk, paged. Pass the full payload path from a previous response; offset/limit are char-based (defaults 0 and 20000). With format=json each envelope is valid JSON; data is a text chunk, concatenate before parsing. items=true pages array rows.

changes.description: Model delta since last capture; format=json for structured output.

content.description: Include page's visible text. model mode only. Use mode=content instead for clean markdown.

extract.description: auto (site-aware; Reddit posts attempt the full tree, inspect complete/partial), json (template), links, forms.

filter.description: Filter by role/name (comma-separated). model mode only.

find.description: Search elements by text. Returns refs + scores.

format.description: text (default) | json — pure JSON output for extract= and artifact= reads (zero preamble; never truncated JSON).

items.description: Artifact: page JSON array rows, not character chunks; offset/limit in items.

limit.description: Max items for extract. Default 50 (Reddit post comments: all available, capped at 1000, unless set). Artifact: chars (default 20000), or rows with items=true (default 50).

logs.description: Console: current document - logs, uncaught errors with stack, failed loads. Network: current navigation.

mode.description: model (default): interactive elements with refs. content: page text as markdown for reading. outline: headings only, ultra-minimal.

offset.description: Artifact read: start char (row with items=true). Default 0.

preview.description: extract=auto: sampled container and fields, without rows.

scope.description: Ref id of element to view subtree text of; with mode=content, returns just that element's subtree as markdown (budget honored).

sort.description: Reddit post auto-extract sort; overrides page sort.

template.description: For extract=json: {"items":{"container":"css","fields":{"name":"css or css@attr"}}}. @attr reads the container attribute. Text reads are RENDERED - a hidden element is omitted (the item lists it in _omitted); read one explicitly with {"sel":"css","raw":true}. Lookups span light DOM, open shadow roots and same-origin frames; skipped frames are reported.

tools.name: state
tools.description: Manage tabs, cookies, storage, sessions, blocking. open-tab opens AND switches, returning an ID; switch-tab/close-tab require target_id. Save after login; navigate to saved origin before load, then reload. Setters require name/value (empty value allowed); ls/ss/cookies preserve full values, large reads offload to JSON artifacts. block affects inert assets, never first-party scripts. compress toggles response pruning. As steps use {action:"state",op:...,...}.

clear.description: Block: true stops blocking. Without classes/clear, returns measured blocked-request count; byte/time savings unmeasured.

name.description: Cookie name, storage key, or session name.

slim.description: Tab lifecycle: retain tab ID, omit model.

url.description: URL for open-tab, cookie scope (set-cookie/del-cookie), or domain filter (cookies).

tools.name: run
tools.description: Sequential act actions (fill/eval included), see/extract reads and state ops with branches/loops. Reuse act/see/state fields. if: {action:"if",condition,text,then:[...],else:[...]}; while: {action:"while",condition,text,steps:[...],max:5}. JS conditions use js=; CSS uses selector=. False branches may finish before timeout on quiet pages; use wait for a deadline. wait+else falls back on timeout. optional:true continues runtime failure locally, including nested steps. Invalid plans fail before effects (1000 steps, nesting 32, while max 0-100). Other failures stop, preserving prior observations/effects; a failed batch stops enclosing run. slim inherits, reads/errors retained. url= navigates before each step; open-tab switches.

format.description: json: {status:completed|stopped,results:[{step,status:ok|optional_failed|failed,output,error?}],stopped_at?,error?,page?,note?}. Steps are 1-based; nested observations stay in output text. Not inherited: set each read's format explicitly. Oversized results use artifact paging.

slim.description: Inherit verdict-only actions; preserve reads and errors.

steps.description: Steps reuse act/see/state fields plus optional:true and if/while branches. wait may carry else:[...].

condition.description: Same condition fields as act wait; js= expression, selector= CSS.

tools.name: vision
tools.description: PNG screenshot for canvas/image UIs, visual checks, or when refs/content cannot answer. marks=true overlays ref badges for visible main-frame elements; frames may be unmarked. Inline unless path= names a file; large PNGs offload to a local artifact. Also a run step. Prefer act/see for structural interactions.

marks.description: Overlay numbered ref badges on visible elements.

path.description: Write the .png here; no inline image.
